title: Argquz Mod
description: This mod adds helpful features from situation to situation!
body:
Argquz Mod is a performance-friendly Minecraft mod designed to enhance player awareness and visual clarity while remaining completely server-friendly and legit.

Included mods:

• Keystrokes Display

• CPS Counter

• Health Indicator (If the server does not allow health indicators, it will not work)

• Better Placement

• Freelook

• Coordinates HUD

• Fire Overlay Reducer
